caveats:
10 JUNE 2019 UPDATE:
The administrative level 3 (posto) feature for “Mieze” (formerly MZ0117, in its own “Pemba” district) has been corrected to belong in the “Metuge” district and has been P-coded MZ010902.


25 APRIL 2019 UPDATE:
Lines file with administrative level coding added to shapefiles.




April 10, 2019 update:

Shapefile projections changed to WGS94
Underscore ("_") characters in feature names changed to spaces.
NO CHANGES MADE TO P-CODES.

Affected resources:
gazetteer:  moz_admbnda_2019_gazetteer_v4
EMF files:  moz_adm_2019_EMF_v2.zip
KMZ files:  moz_adm_2019_KMZ_v2.zip
shapefiles:  moz_adm_2019_SHP_v3


April 8, 2019 update:

EMF files added
KMZ files added
COD-AB data sheet added.

The changes do not alter the previous shapefiles.

The administrative level 1 (province) KMZ file was generated from a generalized shapefile (tolerance 0.001 degree) because of the number of vertices.  The shapefile resource on this dataset is the original.



April 3, 2019 update:  administrative level 4 (settlement) features added for the Maputo City area.

methodology_other: Dataset: Mozambique Administrative Boundaries Level 3 Postos from WFP Geonode / INE  (Census 2007), cleaned by UN OCHA ROSEA.
name: cod-ab-moz
notes:
Mozambique administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 11 Province  
- Admin 2: 159 District  
- Admin 3: 411 Posto  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 24 March 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 07 June 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 20 October 1954: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 20 October 1954: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
